note: A decision cannot reasonably be made until items marked BLOCKING are answered. Known values come from the named plan's published page; nothing here was estimated by this session.

questions.known: The repository now includes four single-city studies plus one dual-city Beijing + Shanghai dashboard. Beijing has 33 starred venues in the 2027 edition; the dual-city study reports 50 Shanghai starred venues in the live 2026 regional guide.
questions.unknown: The brief does not choose Beijing, Shanghai, or a dual-city itinerary; the hotel and restaurant totals are not like-for-like.
questions.action: Choose one city or explicitly choose two; then compare only that city’s room and restaurant shortlist.

questions.known: 15–18 Feb 2027 is a three-night window, shorter than the requested 1–2 weeks. Current candidate dashboards price 15–22 Feb as a seven-night alternative.
questions.unknown: Whether the travellers accept a seven-night stay or select different exact dates.
questions.action: Choose a 7–14-night date range within 15 Feb–23 Mar before using any total.

questions.q: Is one queen-or-larger bed mandatory at the quoted rate?
questions.known: A 26 Nov dual-city snapshot lists compliant examples for 15–22 Feb: Beijing $425 queen with private bath; Shanghai $621 king with private bath (non-refundable; free-cancel option $707). Earlier studies quote different rooms and terms.
questions.unknown: Which city, cancellation policy, member-rate eligibility, and all-in tax amount apply.
questions.action: Select the city and exact room/refund terms, then re-quote before booking.

questions.q: Does the cheapest Shanghai room have a private bathroom?
questions.known: The $696 Hyland rate says 'select your bed' but the fetched rate text did not state bathroom type.
questions.unknown: Attached bathroom for that exact room category.
questions.action: Ask the property in writing or re-read the room page before paying.

questions.q: Are passports and Chinese visas valid for both travellers?
questions.known: State Department page: visa generally required, passport valid 6+ months with blank pages; one study notes registration within 24 hours and at each new address.
questions.unknown: Travellers' nationality, visa status and passport dates.
questions.action: Check both passports and visa eligibility with the official consular source.

questions.q: What is the all-in trip budget ceiling?
questions.known: A later dual-city study lists 7-night room snapshots from $425 in Beijing and $621 in Shanghai, excluding VAT; earlier study totals differ by room type, capture date, and tax treatment. Airfare, visa, city transit and most dinners are not priced.
questions.unknown: Affordable total for the whole trip and whether member/non-refundable prices count.
questions.action: Set an all-in ceiling and compare a same-city shortlist on identical dates, room, cancellation and tax terms.

questions.q: How many starred meals, and at what spend?
questions.known: Only Trb Hutong (Beijing) and T'ang Court (Shanghai) publish exact set-menu totals for two in these plans.
questions.unknown: Per-meal ceiling and number of splurges.
questions.action: Choose a ceiling and shortlist venues with published prices or call for menus.

questions.q: What are the real opening hours and exceptions for each shortlisted venue?
questions.known: A minority of rows have official hours; notably T'ang Court, Yu Garden, Palace Museum, Mutianyu and Trb Hutong.
questions.unknown: Most restaurant hours, Monday closures and holiday exceptions for the exact week.
questions.action: Call the restaurant or use the official WeChat account; record the answer with a date.

questions.q: Can every selected activity and restaurant be reached within one hour by subway or bus?
questions.known: One Shanghai plan publishes a modelled score with declared constants; the other plans refuse to model. No plan has routed door-to-door times.
questions.unknown: Actual journey times on the travel dates.
questions.action: Run a routing query for each selected pair from the final hotel and paste the result into the table.

questions.q: What are the official 2027 mainland holiday dates and make-up workdays?
questions.known: The official State Council English page lists the Spring Festival holiday as 5–13 Feb 2027.
questions.unknown: That page does not list the proposed 31 Jan and 14 Feb make-up workdays; those dates are not verified by the source cited here. Venue-specific hours and exceptions also remain open.
questions.action: Locate an official notice or authoritative translation that explicitly lists make-up workdays, then check each operator’s schedule for venue-specific exceptions.

questions.q: How will the couple pay and get connectivity in China?
questions.unknown: Alipay/WeChat Pay setup, cards, eSIM/VPN availability.
questions.action: Verify with the providers and the official bank/payment help pages before departure.

questions.q: Do hotel totals include tax and service?
questions.known: One study says 10% service included and 6.6% VAT excluded; another says VAT and service excluded; a third says included service and excluded VAT but cannot confirm the base.
questions.unknown: Final payable amount for each quoted room.
questions.action: Ask for an all-in written quote for the exact dates.

questions.known: Not captured. Hutong venues and the Great Wall have stairs and uneven ground; King's Joy offers vegan menus.
questions.action: Answer before choosing hotels and seats.

questions.q: Which MICHELIN edition governs the Shanghai star statuses?
questions.known: The current Shanghai data is the 2026 regional edition. The 2027 Beijing/Tianjin edition is published; the 2027 Shanghai edition was not located.
questions.unknown: Whether any Shanghai status changes before travel.
questions.action: Re-check the official Guide before booking and record the edition date.

questions.q: Are the social links actually reviews of the exact listed branch?
questions.known: This index verifies each video page and labels scope; several videos are about a different branch or the brand as a whole.
questions.unknown: Branch for Da Dong; no Shanghai-specific T'ang Court video was found.
questions.action: Use the links as atmosphere, not as proof of current hours, prices or star level.
